title: Are Pretrained Multilingual Models Equally Fair Across Languages?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance (Precision@k, Mean Reciprocal Rank) and rank correlations on fill-in-the-gap cloze tests against the preferred answers of male versus female annotator groups.

Comparing model performance (Precision@k, Mean Reciprocal Rank) and rank correlations on fill-in-the-gap cloze tests against the preferred answers of native versus non-native speaker annotator groups.
Measuring and comparing the variance in demographic group disparities and overall predictive accuracy of multilingual models across four different languages (English, French, German, and Spanish).
